typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Data Center} as string,
		Platform as string,
		{IFD #} as string,
		Quantity as string,
		{Item Activity} as string,
		Action as string,
		{KW to add or remove} as string,
		Date as string,
		{KW to add or remove 1} as string,
		{Date to Begin} as string,
		{Date to end} as string,
		{Quantity CU} as string,
		{Quantity RU} as string,
		Status as string,
		{Grid Location} as string,
		Notes as string,
		PROJECT as string,
		Created as string,
		Modified as string,
		{NEW ID} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(uploaddate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Action as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		QtyCU as string,
		Platform as string,
		CommitedKW as string,
		Activity as string,
		QtyFrame as string,
		RADatetoEnd as string,
		Project as string,
		QtyRU as string,
		DataCenter as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		GridLocation as string,
		RADatetoBegin as string,
		CommitedDate as string,
		RAKW as string,
		IFD_ as string,
		Notes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		Action,
		UploadDate = uploaddate,
		QtyCU = {Quantity CU},
		Platform,
		CommitedKW = {KW to add or remove},
		Activity = {Item Activity},
		QtyFrame = Quantity,
		RADatetoEnd = {Date to end},
		Project = PROJECT,
		QtyRU = {Quantity RU},
		DataCenter = {Data Center},
		ETLUser,
		GridLocation = {Grid Location},
		RADatetoBegin = {Date to Begin},
		CommitedDate = Date,
		RAKW = {KW to add or remove 1},
		IFD_ = {IFD #},
		Notes),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
